title: e2e timings-1
description: The history `e2e run` keeps in `<output>/timings.json` to start the longest files first. Advisory: a runner that finds any other document reads no history, and a restored file can reorder work, never change a result.

files.description: Milliseconds a target's file took, smoothed over recent runs, keyed `<target>::<project-relative file>`: a target name, then a POSIX path with no `..` segment.
